column1: # Manifest audit table - the contract behind manifests/*.txt
# Four TAB-separated columns, one row per required package:
# build-offline-repo.sh --dry-run-plan fails on drift in either direction:
#   * a row whose package is not pinned in that manifest -> MISSING PACKAGES
#   * a pin in a manifest with no row here               -> PLAN ERROR (rogue pin)
# scripts/install/blueforce-install.sh never reads this file: it is the audit
# trail for humans and for the dry-run plan. Kernel modules and other artifacts
# that are not shipped as .deb files are out of scope.
